item.description: Sabna V.K., Ramya A., Afeefa K., Sameena M.K., Nimmy N., Rajeena P., Salma V.P., and Sajeena C. began ‘Colours’ after completing a assistant dress maker course under Jan Shikshan Sansthan

item.description: Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan would be hearing the case on October 5, 2026

item.title: Keralam considering sites in Thrissur, Kasaragod for proposed All-India Institute of Ayurveda

item.description: A purported video of CPI(M) councillor demanding ₹10 lakh from Sanju, a native of Thirumala, to resolve issues concerning a plot he purchased in the ward, had begun circulating two days ago

item.title: Eating out in Mumbai to get costlier as restaurants plan 10–15% menu price hike
item.description: AHAR cites rising cooking gas prices, food costs, rentals and wages; revised rates likely to be introduced in the coming weeks

item.title: Periyar Arivulagam is Dravidian model government’s brainchild, says Stalin
item.description: Stalin also listed several library and other knowledge-centre projects undertaken by the DMK government, including the Anna Centenary Library in Chennai, the Kalaignar Centenary Library in Madurai, Mudhalvar Padaippagams and the renovation of the Connemara Public Library in Egmore

item.title: Bihar Vigilance raids Rural Works Department engineer in disproportionate assets case
item.description: Vigilance tightens noose around engineer accused of amassing disproportionate assets, conducted simultaneous raids at engineer’s four locations at Chhapra, Patna, Katihar & Darjeeling.

item.title: Reintroduction of tigers in Buxa: What it means for conservation | Explained
item.description: The release of the tigress is not is not merely about bringing tigers back to Buxa but its “objective is to create the conditions in which a tiger population can establish, breed and ultimately become viable and self-sustaining,” PIB said in a statement.

item.title: CJP Tiranga rally: Movement around Connaught place likely to be affected, says Delhi Traffic police
item.description: New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) on Thursday (October 15, 2026) announced that Central Park in Connaught Place would remain closed to the public on October 16 and 17 for “administrative reasons”

item.title: Export levy on petrol hiked, diesel lowered
item.description: There is no change in the duty of either of the retail fuels meant for domestic consumption

item.title: ABVP, BCJD claim victories in Odisha student union elections
item.description: While the ABVP claimed a clean sweep in Ganjam district and said it had dominated in Kendujhar and Mayurbhanj districts, the BCJD said its candidates had won the presidents’ posts at four major universities

item.title: PM Modi to visit to Canada on December 11 and 12
item.description: Sources added that PM Modi will be visiting U.S. for the G20 summit from December 13 to December 15, 2026

item.title: Address attacks on Hindu temples in the U.S., MEA says

item.title: Nine lakh houses for Andhra: Naidu, Chouhan lay foundation for first three lakh under PMAY-G

item.description: In the draft petition, the actor has termed the "leave India" directive "drastic" and argued that no provision under the current law or statutory rules prohibits an OCI cardholder from participating in a peaceful protest

item.title: Keralam’s former Minister Muneer seeks comprehensive probe into Malaysian engineer’s death in 2006
item.description: Gyanesh Kumar, the current Chief Election Commissioner, was Public Works Secretary in the Keralam during the Malaysian engineer’s death in Kuala Lumpur in November 2006.

item.title: Drive to enrol ‘left-out’ voters of Keralam to begin on October 15, 2026

item.title: LDF alleges Thiruvananthapuram BJP councillor R. Sugathan’s signature was forged in council attendance register

item.title: CPI(M) extended district committee meeting in Kozhikode from October 6

item.title: Keralam Health department introduces district-level system to monitor medicine stocks

item.title: Samyukt Kisan Morcha rejects rabi MSP, demands revision
item.description: ‘The government has raised the MSP of wheat by ₹25 a quintal. That is 25 paise a kilo. It will not buy even a third of a litre of diesel. Yet the government calls it a ‘106% profit’,’ the SKM says in a statement

item.title: SFI-police face-off intensifies after ‘inspection’ at SFI leader’s home and protest outside police officers’ residences
item.description: The incidents happened a day after an alleged threat by Cantonment sub-inspector Gokul surfaced in the aftermath of the recent clash between Youth Congress and SFI activists in the capital city

item.title: Wildlife Week: ITREK plants native saplings at Ponmudi

item.title: Thiruvananthapuram Corporation’s BJP councillor R. Sreelekha does a U-turn after resignation bid
item.description: Ms. Sreelekha reportedly mentioned in her ward’s WhatsApp group that she had informed the Mayor through a letter about resigning as a councillor for personal reasons. On Sunday, BJP leaders say she will continue in her position and that she is in hospital

item.title: Pinarayi Vijayan seeks strigent action against YC workers, police over University Hostel violence
item.description: In a letter to the Home Minister, the CPI(M) veteran alleged that the decision by the Youth Congress to commence its march from the hostel premises instead of its usual protest venues was a deliberate attempt to provoke violence

item.title: Victory, not number of seats, is the key: Akhilesh amid SP-Congress seat-sharing spat
item.description: ‘Both the parties will win and form the government in an alliance. When have we talked about defeat? We too are talking about victory...Elections are fought on the basis of ideology. In terms of ideology, the Congress party is number one in the entire country,’ U.P. Congress in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam says

item.title: Voters will teach TVK candidates a befitting lesson: EPS

item.title: Campaign ends for high-stakes bypolls in three States, one U.T.
item.description: The bypolls set to take place on Tuesday (October 6, 2026) will be held in five Assembly constituencies in West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, and Puducherry, as well as in one Lok Sabha seat in Assam; the votes will be counted on Friday

item.title: Narcotic drug offences: Bail can be denied even after one year of incarceration, says Madras HC
